title: Library MCP Server Tools
description: JSON Schema definitions for Library MCP Server tools (003b)

tools.name: search_books
tools.description: Search books by title, author, or keyword. Returns matching books with availability status.

query.description: Search query to match against title or author

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

tools.name: get_book_details
tools.description: Get complete details for a specific book including location and status.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check if a book is available and get its current location.

tools.name: list_by_category
tools.description: List all books in a specific category.

tools.name: list_by_status
tools.description: List all books with a specific availability status.

tools.name: locate_book
tools.description: Get the physical location of a book (Cabinet, Rack, Row).

tools.name: find_books_in_cabinet
tools.description: List all books in a specific cabinet location.

tools.name: get_weak_signal_books
tools.description: Get books with weak RFID signal strength that may need maintenance.

resources.name: Library Statistics
resources.description: Aggregate statistics: book counts by category and status

resources.name: Missing Books List
resources.description: List of all books with Missing status, ordered by last seen timestamp

resources.name: Location Map
resources.description: Distinct Cabinet/Rack/Row combinations with book counts

prompts.name: book_search
prompts.description: Generate a natural language book search query

arguments.name: query
arguments.description: What the user is looking for

prompts.name: library_status_report
prompts.description: Generate a status report for the library

arguments.name: focus
arguments.description: Area to focus on (availability, maintenance, categories)
